name: Caitlyn
source: An employee at Sunny Shine Funland. In fact, she has been working at the park since its opening. Before working here, she used to work at Sunny Springs Casino. Working there, she was the sharpest game show host as she obtained the best tips and most compliments. She left since Mr. Wazlow offered a job with better pay. She dreams of being the manager of the park, so she could eventually move to even higher positions. Caitlyn is very confident and competitive. She often gets into arguments with Brianna.
